section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants of a study, comprising 310 Dutch-speaking female undergraduates with a mean age of 21.31 years and a mean BMI of 22.14 kg/m². The sample was limited to women due to practical constraints at the data collection sites, which predominantly comprised female students. The majority of participants identified as being of Dutch, German, Belgian, or mixed-Dutch ethnic descent.
